strapiBlog.title: AVENEW Development Appoints Al Tamayoz Contracting for Prestigious Rena Project
strapiBlog.short_description: AVENEW Development has officially appointed Al Tamayoz Contracting Co. LLC as the main contractor for its prestigious Rena project, an exclusive beachfront residential development on the renowned Dubai Islands.

data.text:
AVENEW Development has officially appointed Al Tamayoz Contracting Co. LLC as the main contractor for its prestigious Rena project, an exclusive beachfront residential development on the renowned Dubai Islands.

This strategic partnership underscores AVENEW Development's commitment to delivering unparalleled luxury and quality in Dubai's real estate market.

Rena at Dubai Islands is poised to redefine coastal living by offering residents an exquisite blend of modern design and natural beauty. The residences are meticulously crafted to maximize natural light and provide expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, ensuring a harmonious living experience that seamlessly integrates indoor comfort with the serene beachfront environment.

The collaboration between AVENEW Development and Al Tamayoz Contracting brings together two entities renowned for their dedication to excellence. Established in 2014, Al Tamayoz Contracting has a distinguished track record of delivering high-quality developments across the UAE. Their expertise in construction and commitment to superior craftsmanship align perfectly with AVENEW Development's vision for Rena.

Rasha Hassan, Managing Partner of AVENEW Development, expressed enthusiasm about the partnership, stating, “We are thrilled to partner with Al Tamayoz Contracting Co for the next phase of Rena’s development. Their expertise and commitment to excellence align perfectly with our vision to deliver a world-class exceptional living environment.”

Echoing this sentiment, Samer Roushdy Mousa, Managing Partner of Al Tamayoz Contracting, remarked, “We are proud to collaborate with AVENEW Development on Rena, a project that embodies sophistication and innovation. Our team is dedicated to executing this vision with precision, ensuring that every detail meets the highest standards of quality and craftsmanship.”

data.text:
About Rena on Dubai Islands

Rena is a ground plus seven-floor development comprising 64 exclusive units, including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as 2-bedroom duplex townhouses. Residents will enjoy direct beach access, an infinity rooftop pool, and a state-of-the-art gym. The project is expected to be completed by the second quarter of 2027 and offers a flexible 60/40 payment plan, making it an attractive investment opportunity.

For investors seeking prime opportunities in Dubai's luxury real estate market, Rena at Dubai Islands presents an unparalleled proposition. With the expertise of Zoya Ventures Real Estate, discerning investors can navigate this exclusive offering to secure a residence that epitomizes beachfront elegance and modern sophistication.

faqs.question: What types of residences are available at Rena at Dubai Islands?

data.answer: Rena offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, 2-bedroom duplex townhouses, and a luxurious penthouse, all designed to provide expansive views and modern comfort.

faqs.question: When is the expected completion date for Rena at Dubai Islands?

data.answer: The development is scheduled for completion in the second quarter of 2027, aligning with AVENEW Development Dubai's commitment to timely delivery.

faqs.question: What amenities can residents expect at Rena?

data.answer: Residents will have access to direct beach access, an infinity rooftop pool, a modern gym, and landscaped gardens, enhancing the beachfront residential experience in Dubai.

faqs.question: What is the payment plan for purchasing a residence in Rena?

data.answer: Rena offers a flexible 60/40 payment plan, with a 10% down payment, 50% during construction, and 40% upon handover, facilitating a convenient investment process in Dubai Islands property investment.

data.answer: Investors can consult with Zoya Ventures Real Estate for comprehensive insights and assistance in securing a property at Rena, ensuring informed decisions in Dubai beachfront properties.
